posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
My wife and I are in Dayton, and regularly game with the Wittenberg Role-Playing Guild in Springfield.

While its a little bit of a drive from Columbus, they hold weekly board game nights every Saturday during the academic year, and hold their own gaming convention in late March.

SotM is actually the featured game next Saturday, February 23rd, so it's guaranteed that it'll be played there.

Their convention this year is actually one month later, March 23rd, from 11am till midnight.
